n3.name: Click on the link that says '22 used' to see used books available

n4.name: Click on the 'Add to Cart' button for the second book

n5.name: Click on the 'Proceed to Checkout' button

n6.name: Enter email address and select the option 'I am a new customer'

n7.name: Click on the 'Sign in using our secure server' button

n8.name: Enter customer details and click on the 'Create account' button

n9.name: Enter shipping details and click on the 'Continue' button

n10.name: Select preferred shipping options and click on 'Continue'

n11.name: Choose payment method and enter credit card details

n12.name: Click on the 'Add your card' button to save card information

n14.name: Choose billing address and select the option to use the chosen address

n15.name: Click on 'Place your order in AUD' to complete the process
